summary: Frontend-only redesign smoke + full UI test. All requested data-testids are present and correct across Home and inner pages. Photo header panels, page-intro-XX, page-title-XX, page-back-XX all resolve with correct titles (Projets, Compétences, Certifications, À propos, Coulisses, Contact). Dark mode is default on fresh visit; theme-toggle switches html.dark. Topbar becomes 'is-scrolled' after scroll > 40px. Explorer / mobile-menu-drawer open. Contact form renders with full-width orange submit (not submitted). Empty state visible on /projets. About portrait & about-contact-cta present. However, a CRITICAL horizontal overflow bug exists on Home (both desktop and mobile) caused by the TechMarquee section, plus two 404 CDN icons in the tools strip.

ui_bugs.issue: Root <section> has no overflow-hidden; inner motion.div has `w-max` (~4480–4980px). Body horizontal scroll on desktop (scrollW 5104 vs 1920) AND on mobile (scrollW 3678 vs 390). This breaks the 'no horizontal overflow' requirement and makes mobile layout scroll sideways.

Two broken images (404): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@thesvg/icons/icons/vapi.svg and https://cdn.simpleicons.org/openai . Console logs show 404s. Replace with valid CDN URLs (e.g. https://cdn.simpleicons.org/openai/FFFFFF works but bare openai returned 404 here; vapi icon path is wrong).

issues: Horizontal scrollbar visible due to TechMarquee (see above).

action_items: Add `overflow-hidden` (and probably `w-screen`/`w-full` with proper clipping) to the TechMarquee root <section> in src/components/TechMarquee.tsx so the `w-max` inner track cannot expand the page. Also verify the outer page containers don't allow `min-width: max-content` propagation.
Replace the 2 broken tech logo URLs (OpenAI + Vapi) in the tools logos list — currently 404 in Network.
critical_code_review_comments: TechMarquee: parent section lacks overflow clipping while child uses w-max → guaranteed page-level horizontal scroll. Standard marquee pattern needs the OUTER wrapper (not the middle mask div) to clip.

Explorer panel: on desktop, clicking explorer-toggle did not expose a `data-testid="explorer-panel"` in the DOM query (mobile shows equivalent list inside mobile-menu-drawer). Consider unifying testids so `explorer-panel` is always addressable when open on desktop (may just need the testid attribute added to the popover container).

Certifications page: no `data-testid` prefix on individual cards was found via `[data-testid^="cert-"]`; if you want deterministic per-item selection, add `data-testid="cert-<i>"` to each certification card (home already uses `home-cert-i`).
hero-index only exposes categories through a single container testid; per-item testids would be useful but not required by the spec.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all testids + routing + theme + forms OK; 1 critical layout bug + 2 broken images)

rca of the issue: Horizontal overflow RCA: In /app/src/components/TechMarquee.tsx the root <section class='px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-12 max-w-[1800px] mx-auto'> does NOT set overflow-hidden. The inner marquee track uses `className='flex items-center gap-16 md:gap-20 w-max'` which sizes to intrinsic content (~4500–5000px, i.e. the duplicated logo row for the -50% translate animation). Because the closest ancestor with `overflow: hidden` is the middle mask div (which is w-full — but w-full resolves to the section's own now-expanded width, so it inherits the overflow), the whole page ends up wider than the viewport. Fix: add `overflow-hidden w-full` (and optionally `max-w-screen`) to the root <section>, or wrap the motion.div in a strictly viewport-bounded container. Repro: open the site at 390x844 or 1920x1080 and check document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth.
